svg.title: Exception id map
svg.desc: Class tree: std::exception is the base of json::exception, which is the base of the five exception families parse_error (ids 1xx), invalid_iterator (2xx), type_error (3xx), out_of_range (4xx) and other_error (5xx). Each family lists the ids documented on this page, 68 in total; every id links to its section.
